caveats: Raw is priced two ways: lossless PNG over six uint16 planes, and CCSDS 123.0-B-1 over six uint8 planes at the corpus's true depth. CCSDS 123 is the standard that actually flies and is the number to quote; the PNG row is kept because earlier results used it.
Neither raw row is the float32 array held in memory, which would roughly double the raw cost and flatter OSP for free.
Briefs are priced as minified JSON; the protobuf encoding is ~2.4x smaller, so the brief cost reported here is conservative.
Ground-side detection uses the same detector and threshold as onboard, so pixel strategies are not handicapped.
Recall counts objects on undelivered tiles as missed.
Pixels can be re-analysed later and briefs cannot; that cost does not appear on this curve.
